$description: Semantic / purpose color tier — LIGHT mode set. These are the --mf-* roles components consume; every value is a DTCG alias into the raw base tier (tokens/base/color.json). Names map onto MD3 color-role vocabulary (foreground == MD3 'on-' role); see tokens/README.md for the full MD3 mapping and the old-shadcn-var crosswalk. This file and color.dark.json define the SAME token paths with mode-appropriate values — task 002 builds each mode from its own file (they are alternative source sets, not merged together).

primary-hover.$description: NEW role (no styles.css value; components today use hover:bg-primary/90 opacity). Slightly lightened primary.

brand-highlight.$description: NEW role. Placeholder = primary; mod-core's palette is achromatic, so no distinct brand accent exists. Expected to be overridden by brand style packages (e.g. Liquid Labs).

tertiary.$description: NEW role (MD3 tertiary). Defaults to secondary's surface — mod-core has no distinct tertiary today.

tertiary-foreground.$description: NEW role (MD3 on-tertiary). Defaults to secondary-foreground.

accent.$description: shadcn --accent (emphasis surface, e.g. hovered menu items). Shares surface-variant's background but a stronger foreground. Kept as a distinct role so task 002 preserves --color-accent exactly.

text-heading.$description: NEW role. Defaults to text-body; distinct token so headings can diverge later.

text-muted.$description: Muted/secondary text. Same value as surface-variant-foreground (shadcn --muted-foreground).

link.$description: NEW role (no styles.css value). Given a perceivable blue for accessibility; overridable by style packages.

error-foreground.$description: MD3 on-error. NEW (styles.css has no --destructive-foreground); white on the mid-tone red.

warning-foreground.$description: NEW role. Dark text on amber.
